cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose the trophy ceremony or our anniversary dinner. They're at the same time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can move dinner to tomorrow. Say you're choosing the trophy tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It could be a short ceremony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll keep tonight's table if you'll leave before your name is called. Will you?
